analysis.trend: per replicate OLS slope of log(S4/MLP) on log2(F/l) over the three ratios of an axis
analysis.kernel_contrast: log(S4/MLP) at OU minus at RBF, per replicate, at each geometry and averaged over the five geometries

protocol.frozen_before: Any scored training or test-set inspection for this scan
protocol.status: Supplementary/exploratory. Does not rewrite any Task 1-3 result, pass flag or earlier study.
protocol.question: How does the GP-source AdaLN-MLP vs S4 (and whitened MLP) gap depend on kernel roughness and on the window-to-lengthscale ratio F/l?
protocol.hypothesis: S4's advantage over AdaLN MLP grows with F/l and with kernel roughness (RBF < Matern-5/2 < Matern-3/2 < OU).
protocol.kernels: Rasmussen-Williams Matern parametrization, unit grid, variance 1, nugget 1e-6 for every kernel; matched GP source is the raw kernel on the horizon grid as in main.
protocol.geometry: F/l in {2,4,8} via F in {16,32,64} at l=8 with lookback 2F (horizon axis) and via l in {8,4,2} at F=16 (lengthscale axis); F16_l8 is on both axes.
protocol.widths: MLP width 56 at every F; S4 width chosen per F to match total trainable parameters (56/57/59).
protocol.replication: Three independent data draws, each with its own optimization seed; heads and sources paired within a draw.
protocol.training: As configs/main.json: 6000 updates, batch 256, AdamW lr 1e-3 constant, weight decay 1e-4 (no decay on SSM parameters), clip 1, validation-only checkpoint every 500 steps, Euler 64.
protocol.geometry_gate: Top-2 velocity energy and Task-1 branch are reported per cell; the 0.9 gate is not enforced.
protocol.metrics: Original-coordinate per-PC velocity MSE (PC1, PC2, literal residual 3..F, above-floor and sub-floor residual groups), roughness and literal rule, fair CRPS on 256 contexts x 32 draws, privileged analytic-oracle gaps.
